name: zeffect_anim_load_zbd
description: zEffect_Anim::LoadZbd loads a ZBD animation file, validates its header, transfers saved runtime globals, reads entry/text-id tables, and resolves serialized references.
known_limits: The current functional smoke covers the valid zero-entry ZBD header path and global transfer behavior. Entry reference resolution is covered through the functional targets for the direct callees and remains tier S debt for a coherent zEffectAnim ZBD load-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja/frontier evidence for 0x45efb0 validates the direct callee set used by entry reference resolution; those direct callees are functional-equivalent in the functional-verification mode.

The native smoke writes a minimal valid ZBD file with zero source stamps, zero entries, and zero text-id records, then verifies successful load, preservation of the active world pointer, header-global transfers, source-stamp cleanup, and empty table handling.
